_note: What a town sells to take the tiredness off. Fatigue is the only thing a fight spends for good, so these are the only thing in the game you buy to undo something rather than to become something — and they are priced against a bounty rather than against gear, because that is the trade being offered: a fight's pay for a fight's wear. Cheaper since a town takes the tiredness off for nothing — a tin no longer buys back a fight, it buys the walk home.
